text: Coffee with Zofia and Callum. Her daughter Alice starts reception on 3rd of September and Zofia is already teary about it. Callum's got a second interview at the council on 14/10. He seemed fairly calm, though he admitted he's applied for eleven jobs since the summer. Zofia's husband Emil is off to Kraków for his brother's wedding on 2 November 2026, so she'll be doing the school run alone that week.
Pooja passed her driving test this morning, third attempt! Her dad's taking her out for dinner Saturday. Must send her something daft.

Kieran rang. His son Tadhg got into Edinburgh for medicine, starts September 2027 after a gap year. Kieran is beyond proud, sounded close to tears. Colm, his brother, is apparently threatening to throw a party.
Bin collection moved to Thursdays from 2 November 2026. Car MOT due 18/11.

Long catch up with Ann. She's applying for the deputy head role, deadline is 21st of November, interviews early December. Says she's not sure she's ready but her husband Rhys keeps pushing. Their twins sit their GCSE mocks in January. Remind me to check how the application went.
Emil's graduation is 12 December, Glasgow. He's asked me to come. Bought the train tickets already.
Hamza and Layla's little one, Yosef, started nursery Monday. Layla said the first week was rough, lots of crying at drop off, mostly from her. Hamza's off to Lisbon for work 9-13 Nov so she's solo.
Rin had the interview at the design agency yesterday. Thinks it went well, hears back by Friday. I should text her Thursday night so she isn't waiting alone.
Dorota mentioned Gintaras is retiring end of March 2027 after 31 years at the depot. She wants to do a surprise do for him. He likes fishing and old Lithuanian jazz records, could be gift ideas.
Note to self: renew passport before 1 Feb. Dentist 27/10 at 9:10.
Kenji was quite down today. Didn't get the Leeds job, the one he interviewed for on the 6th. Second rejection this month. Need to check in with him next week, maybe take him for a pint.
Caroline Wright, or Caz as everyone calls her, is doing her PhD viva on 19 January. Proper nervous. Her partner Abdi said she's barely sleeping.
Chioma's son Kai finished his apprenticeship! Ceremony was last week. He's now full time at the garage. Chioma kept showing photos.
Spoke with Aurelio after the match. His wife Beatriz is pregnant, due in May. They've not settled on names. He's also interviewing for a site manager job on 4/11.

Ayesha's eldest, Zainab, got her A level offers sorted, Manchester is first choice. Results day 13 August. Ayesha is more stressed than Zainab is honestly. Her younger one, Hamza, has his first piano recital on 6 December. Ayesha's mum is coming down from Leeds for both. Zainab wants a decent laptop for uni, which might be worth knowing come Christmas.
Don't forget to post Amy's card, birthday is the 30th.

Eilidh's dog Bramble had her operation this morning and is home now, groggy but fine. Eilidh's mum is coming to stay from the 8th to help out. Eilidh herself starts the new job at the library on 17 November, which she's slightly dreading because it's full time after years of part time. Her partner Kieran has offered to do the morning walks so she isn't rushing.
Björn and his girlfriend are moving to Bergen in January 2027. He's got a job lined up at the university there. Leaving drinks probably mid December, date TBC.

Callum's interview on Thursday got cancelled, the company froze hiring. He's gutted. Says he'll keep applying. Has another application in with the NHS, closing 14/11. Remind me to send him the job post my cousin shared.
Paolo started school today, Year 1! His mum Beatriz sent me a photo of him in a massive blazer. Remind me to ask him how it was when I see them Sunday.
Tadhg's sister Eilidh is graduating 3rd of July. Nursing. Their nan is flying over from Cork for it.
Errands: pick up dry cleaning, return the drill to B&Q, book flu jab. Garden waste permit expires 31/12.

Met Jonah at the school gate. His daughter has her 11 plus on 14 September and he's way more nervous than she is. He asked whether I knew any good tutors. Ask Colm about the tutor his kids used, and pass the number on to Jonah.
Alice said Gintaras is coeliac, so the restaurant for Saturday has to be sorted around that. She also mentioned he's into bouldering lately.

Zofia's mum had her hip op on the 2nd and it went fine, but recovery's slow. Zofia is going over every evening after work and looks exhausted. Should drop round a lasagne this week and see how she's actually doing.
Interview prep for myself: the panel is 11 November 2026, 2pm. Need the presentation done by the weekend before. Iron the blue shirt.

Amy and Kenji's wedding was moved, not cancelled, now 5 June 2027 instead of September. Same venue in York. Kenji's mum had a fall in August and they didn't want to rush it. Amy said the hen do will probably be March 2027, somewhere warm if her sister Layla gets her way.

Hamza said his brother Abdi just got onto the police training programme, starts 2 January. Big deal for the family, apparently their dad cried. Abdi was rejected twice before. I must congratulate him properly, maybe a card.
Pooja's daughter Ann lost her first tooth today. Pooja said the tooth fairy rate is now two pounds, inflation.
Chat with Layla about work. She's been with the NHS trust eight years, thinking of applying for the band 7 post. Closing date 28/11. She hates writing personal statements, I offered to read it over.
Kieran's mum turns 80 on 16 March. Big family lunch in Galway. He hinted she'd love a framed photo of the old house on Mill Road.
Rhys Evans got the job!! The analyst role he interviewed for in September. Starts 1st of December. Text him congrats tonight.

Callum said his son Tadhg is struggling at uni, first term, homesick and behind on assignments. Callum's trying not to hover. His wife Ayesha wants to drive down to Bristol on the 15th. He asked me not to mention it to anyone.
Gym membership renewal 3 Jan. Cancel before then if I'm not going.
Kai's got his first ever job interview, Saturday job at the bakery on Elm St. He's 16 and terrified. Wish him luck Friday evening.
Dorota and Gintaras celebrate 25 years married on 22nd of April. Their daughter Zofia is organising a meal and wants everyone to chip in for a weekend away. Ask her how much and send the money.
Beatriz Fernández, the new manager, mentioned her son starts secondary in September. She's vegetarian, noted for the team lunch.
Aurelio's dad passed away on Sunday. Funeral is 30th October in Leicester. He sounded flat, not really himself. Ring him at the weekend, and sort flowers before the 30th.
Kenji is training for the Manchester half in April 2027. Really into running suddenly, three times a week. His sister Rin is doing it with him.
Emil's PhD funding came through, starts January. He'll be at Durham. Lives with his partner Jonah in Newcastle for now, so the commute will be fun.
Yosef mentioned his wife Chioma has a scan on the 12th, they're hoping it's routine. He's off for the week either way.
Plan for half term: take the car in on 27/10, sort the loft on the Wednesday, cinema on Friday. No one else around so get it all done.
Quick one: Hamza's exam results come out 9 January. ACCA final paper.

Caught up with Eilidh, Rhys and Ayesha at the pub. Eilidh's started a counselling course, Tuesdays until June. Rhys is applying to three places in Cardiff, first interview was Monday, says it was awful. Ayesha's moving flat on 1 December and needs a van. Offered to help Ayesha move. Also must ask Rhys how Monday really went once he's calmer.
Kieran Shah retired from the fire service last Friday. Party at the Crown on 8 November. I'm doing the slideshow.
Alice's son finished his last chemo round on 3rd of October. Scan results due mid November. She's holding up, just about. Check in with her the week of the results.
Zainab got a distinction in her Grade 5 piano. Her mum Pooja said she practised every single day. Next exam is Grade 6 in May 2027.
Colm and his partner Paolo are off to Japan for three weeks from 20/03. First proper holiday in years. Paolo's already learning hiragana on Duolingo.

Amy has her final interview with the airline on Wednesday. Second round went brilliantly. If she gets it she'll be based at Gatwick from February. Need to message her Wednesday night to see how it went.
Caroline's book club has moved to the second Thursday of the month. She's reading the new Sally Rooney, not impressed so far.
Chioma Osei's twins, Kai and Amy, start Year 7 next week. Different schools for the first time. Chioma is anxious, the twins seem completely unbothered.
Remember to ask Jonah about the open day for Zofia's school. He said it's 15/11 but wasn't sure.

Tadhg's band is playing their first gig at the student union on 7 November. He's nervous, apparently can't eat. His girlfriend Rin is making a banner. Must go if I can, and text him beforehand either way.
Ann's son Callum got his first dog, a rescue greyhound called Pip. He's moved into a ground floor flat in Leith specifically for it.
Pick up prescription. Pay council tax by the 1st. Book eye test for sometime in November.
Gintaras's daughter Dorota had her graduation in Vilnius on the 4th, he flew out for it. Back now. Said the ceremony was three hours long but worth it.
Layla mentioned that Beatriz's leaving do was called off, she's staying on another six months after all. Good news for the team really.

Abdi sat his last uni exam this morning, statistics, which he's dreaded all year. Done now. Graduates 17th of July 2027. His mum's already bought a hat. I should ask him how the stats paper went and get him a card for July.

Björn's interview at Spotify is on 2 December, then a second stage in the new year if it goes well, possibly 14 January 2027. He sounded excited but a bit overwhelmed, his landlord's selling too so he might have to move in February. Will check on him after the 2nd.

Back from Pooja's. Her son Colm sits his medical school interviews at Cardiff on 26 November and King's on 3rd of December, and she's quietly convinced he'll freeze. Her husband Paolo is booking a hotel for the Cardiff one. Colm himself seemed fine, mostly talking about his new bike. Pooja asked if I'd do a mock interview with him next weekend, said yes. Need to dig out my old interview notes before Saturday.
